dataset.what: Underwater portraits Fuobe shot or licensed with AI-training rights.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbunderwater style, " and goes on in one or two long sentences (Z-Image style): who or what is in the picture, where, the light and the framing.
Describe the scene, never the look the LoRA learns (no "grainy", "film look" or the like), so the trigger carries it.
No names of people, places that identify someone, brands, camera models or photographers.
